notes.title: patch EA0.03a: Testing Leaderboard for multiplayer
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373517/b36fdd9d212881e1af56b8e6e292d5259ae5e9f9.jpg[/img]
We've implemented leaderboard to keep record of player's stats in the Free-for-all and Escort mode.  The stats being tracked including kills, death, games played, games won.  

There's also a leaderboard for the Big Race maps (two maps).

We are still testing this leaderboards, so come and help us leave some records for the above game modes!  We will also be adding leaderboard for the single player and co-op mode.

How do you fare against other players?  Come in and play!!

What other stats should we be tracking?  Let us know!

notes.title: Our first major Update: Co-op Escort mode!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373517/1a45ef8e04f1282642f2221a30030a65e6b369b8.jpg[/img]

We have heard many feedback and suggestions about adding co-op game modes that allow players to team up against A.I.  This was a great suggestion as the VR community is still small and it is difficult to always find people to play Team game modes.  

So we've been hard at work with a new Co-op Escort game mode.  Similar to our beloved Team Escort game mode, in Co-op escort, players team up to escort a airship to the destination, while fighting off the A.I.  This allows for 1-4 players in each game.

We've added some new A.I that we're quite happy with.  These drones use a different algorithm for flying path finding and have great performance and really gives life to the A.I.

We will continue to refine this game mode, so let us know what you think!  Going foward we will develop more co-op game modes.  One of the idea is a Co-op Base defense against A.I.  Do you have have any other co-op ideas?

Give this Co-op Escort mode a try, and let us know of your thoughts!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373517/437f084666e2fc081d3a85d5f5cff7ee147676b5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: bug fixes 0.01c
notes.notes:
1. single play mode should not be able to hear other players any more.
2. fall to death (drowned in water) message should be fixed now so that it only happens when player drops below the map.  (now should read "fell to death").
3. sometimes players respawn after death and would appear to be invisible from other player's view. This should be fixed now.

notes.title: Features and bug fixes added, 12/09 beta test
notes.notes:
- live camera screen added at the finish line.  Camera will follow the leading player and project onto the screen.
- Leader board for Big Race mode updated.
- Race time penalty calculated based on rings missed.  1 second for each missed ring.
- Jet-9 tilt head to turn feature added.
- LOD added for map1.
- invisible bug (players sometimes become invisible after death) from last week - need to test with hotkey M and N to see if related to avatarFX "avatarVisible" function.
